content: FINRA Rule 2214 requires investment-analysis tools to disclose hypothetical/non-guaranteed nature of projections; Rule 2111.03 carves out educational communications from suitability rules as long as no specific security is recommended for an individual. Practical safe-harbor pattern used by free tools: label all output 'educational purposes only', state 'not personalized investment advice', avoid direct buy/sell directives, focus on general/historical/hypothetical information.
